## What content needs to change?

Describe the specific content (text, image, price, etc.) that needs to be updated.

## Location on site

- Page: [e.g. /services, /about, /contact]
- Section: [e.g. "Pricing", "Biography", "FAQ"]
- File (if known): [e.g. app/services/ServicesContent.tsx]

## Current content

Paste or describe what is currently shown.

## New content

Paste the exact replacement text, or describe the change.

## Reason for change

Why does this content need to be updated? (accuracy, pricing change, new info, legal review, etc.)

## Deadline

Is there a time constraint on this update?

## Files / assets to attach

If this involves a new image, PDF guide, or other asset, attach it here.
